name: Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer
beschreibung:
Located in the charming village of Ebbs, Gasthaus Wildauer features contemporary holiday apartments paired with a traditional restaurant serving hearty local specialities.

The Fohlenhof Ebbs stud farm, the Zahmer Kaiser mountains, and the fortress town of Kufstein are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus-Appartement Wildauer in Ebbs combines authentic Tyrolean inn culture with spacious holiday flats.
